/v1/car-dealer/financing-calculator

monthlyInstallment

monthlyOutflow

insuranceMonthly
. The financing calculator endpoint returns these two fields for each offer result. monthlyOutflow
 represents the total monthly amount including insurance. insuranceMonthly
 represents the monthly insurance amount. Existing response fields remain unchanged and backward compatible. Swagger / API documentation is updated accordingly. Existing calculator functionality continues to work without regression.
